allow: PowerShell($data = Get-Content "D:\\modern\\scraper\\arriscraft-stone.json" | ConvertFrom-Json; $collections = $data | Where-Object { $_.collection } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty collection | Sort-Object -Unique; Write-Host "Collections \($\($collections.Count\)\):"; $collections)

PowerShell(Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:5000/api/products/filters?material=Stone" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty data | Select-Object -ExpandProperty manufacturersWithCollections | Select-Object name, @{n='collectionCount';e={$_.collections.Count}})

PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:5000/api/products?material=Brick&manufacturer=Arriscraft+International&limit=5"; Write-Host "Total:"; $r.meta.total; Write-Host "Products:"; $r.data | Select-Object -Property @{n='name';e={$_.name}}, @{n='material';e={$_.material}}, @{n='collection';e={$_.collection}} | ConvertTo-Json)

PowerShell($response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://modern-masonry-group.vercel.app/api/products/filters?material=Brick" -Method Get; $arriscraft = $response.manufacturersWithCollections | Where-Object { $_.manufacturer -match "Arriscraft" }; if \($arriscraft\) { Write-Host "Arriscraft collections \($\($arriscraft.collections.Count\)\):"; $arriscraft.collections | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $_" } } else { Write-Host "No Arriscraft found" })

PowerShell($response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://modern-masonry-group.vercel.app/api/products/filters?material=Brick" -Method Get; $response.manufacturersWithCollections | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$\($_.manufacturer\): $\($_.collections.Count\) collections" })

PowerShell($response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://modern-masonry-group.vercel.app/api/products/filters?material=Brick" -Method Get; $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Select-Object -First 100)

PowerShell($response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://modern-masonry-group.vercel.app/api/products/filters?material=Brick" -Method Get; $mwc = $response.data.manufacturersWithCollections; Write-Host "Total manufacturers: $\($mwc.Count\)"; $mwc | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$\($_.manufacturer\): $\($_.collections.Count\) collections" })
